property_summary: When every underlying transferFrom call succeeds, C.transfer always completes and returns true.
C.transfer reverts whenever the tos and vs arrays have different lengths, and never otherwise modifies Ether balances of c.
C.transfer reverts (propagating failure) when the target contract's transferFrom returns success=false.
C.transfer always reverts when contract_address is address(0) or the address of C itself, due to the validAddress modifier.
C.transfer always reverts when the tos (or vs) array is empty, since length>0 is required.
When the arrays are non-empty, equally long, and the contract address is valid, c.transfer either reverts or returns true; it never returns false.

When the arrays are empty or have different lengths, c.transfer always reverts (and the transaction returns false on success path otherwise omitted); more precisely: if tos.length==0 or vs.length==0 or tos.length!=vs.length, the call reverts.
If the target address has no code and the arrays each have exactly one element, c.transfer always succeeds and returns true.
